value: A finetune.py burst with the memory-mapped replay pool (60cc028) peaks at 0.70 GB at 4 threads (job 0304, burst 0276's config; 0276 on the old code 3.81 GB). Its curves match 0276's to 5 digits for 3 epochs and drift by at most 0.00219 val MSE after: the input layout widened between the pins (act1-content's six exhaust effects), the pool data are identical apart from all-zero added columns; so training is unchanged by the pool change.
